FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.a1: SnapLead combines global data with advanced AI to not just find leads, but score them and generate the exact assets you need to close them.
FAQ.q2: Can I use it in any country?
FAQ.a2: Yes, our data covers businesses worldwide across over 18 languages.
FAQ.q3: Do you offer a free trial?
FAQ.a3: We offer a 7-day risk-free trial on all our plans.
